title: Prime Minister shares an article by Vice President Thiru C. P. Radhakrishnan highlighting the role of Eklavya Model Residential Schools in empowering tribal students
body_text:
The Prime Minister, Shri Narendra Modi, has shared an article written by the Vice President, Thiru C. P. Radhakrishnan. The article outlines the evolution of Eklavya Model Residential Schools (EMRS) and their role in creating new opportunities for tribal children through quality education and holistic development. It highlights key initiatives such as bridge courses, bilingual teaching, technology-enabled classrooms, sports and vocational training, alongside the achievements of students entering IITs, AIIMS and other premier institutions. The Prime Minister’s Office posted on X: “Eklavya Model Residential Schools are creating new opportunities for tribal children through quality education. On Janjatiya Gaurav Diwas, Hon'ble @VPIndia, Thiru @CPR_VP, writes about the evolution of EMRS and its role in providing quality education and holistic development to tribal students. He highlights initiatives such as bridge courses, bilingual teaching, technology-enabled classrooms, sports and vocational training, along with the achievements of students who are now entering IITs, AIIMS and other premier institutions. A must-read!” Eklavya Model Residential Schools are creating new opportunities for tribal children through quality education.

On Janjatiya Gaurav Diwas, Hon'ble @VPIndia, Thiru @CPR_VP, writes about the evolution of EMRS and its role in providing quality education and holistic development to tribal students.

He highlights initiatives such as bridge courses, bilingual teaching, technology-enabled classrooms, sports and vocational training, along with the achievements of students who are now entering IITs, AIIMS and other premier institutions.
